Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2081
Second Session
Meeting Number - 34
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Thursday, Ashadh 25, 2081
(Third Meeting)
6:20 PM
Management Work
1. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present a proposal to "Consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2081".
2. Honourable Minister for Finance Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal to "Consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Prevention of Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2081".
3. Honourable Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration Pratibha Rawal will present a proposal to "Consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2081".
4. Honourable Minister for Health and Food Hygiene Nisha Mehta will present a proposal to "Consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Health Science Education, 2081".
Panch Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.summary_en: On behalf of the Prime Minister, four ministers will present proposals to consider amendments made by the National Assembly to various bills. These include the Public Procurement Bill, the Prevention of Money Laundering Bill, the Cooperatives Bill, and the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Health Science Education.
